after.text: Obsoleted on 2026-09-09 by BUG-260830-j1o8av, landed in #39. There is no supported source to install lldb-mcp from: Homebrew llvm 23 ships neither lldb nor lldb-mcp, and Apple Xcode LLDB has no MCP support. The bootstrap this task would have delivered was removed instead of completed. Closed rather than done: no helper was installed.
